title: DCP Plugin Configuration (model-driven range-only fork)
description: Configuration schema for the pi-dcp-migrate fork: one model-driven range compression tool, fixed guidance, and a single soft context-usage reminder. Unknown keys (except $schema) are rejected and invalid configuration fails closed: the extension refuses to load. No default config file is created automatically.

audit.description: 本地全量压缩审计。仅全局配置或 PI_CONFIG_DIR 允许；项目 .pi 中出现此字段即拒绝加载。默认关闭，不采集 provider 请求或凭据，不自动删除历史。

$schema.description: JSON Schema reference for IDE autocomplete

enabled.description: Enable or disable the DCP extension. When false, no tool, command or context modification is registered.

protectedFilePatterns.description: Glob patterns for files whose tool outputs are appended to compression summaries (e.g., '**/*.config.ts')

protectedTools.description: Tool names or wildcard patterns whose completed outputs are appended to the compression summary. Merged (deduplicated) with the built-in default ["subagent"]. Supports glob wildcards: * matches any characters, ? matches a single character (e.g., "mcp_*", "my_tool_?")

protectTags.description: Preserve text wrapped in <protect>...</protect> when compressed

protectUserMessages.description: Append the user messages of the compressed range verbatim to the summary

thresholdPercent.description: Percentage of the model context window (approximated from the latest valid usage) at which the soft reminder is added. Must be finite and strictly between 0 and 100. The reminder never forces compression.

minMessageInterval.description: Minimum number of valid canonical messages between two reminder anchors. Positive integer.
